semantic_model.name: court_usage
semantic_model.description: Court slot activity at ZTC, authored in the Apache Ossie format rather than dbt YAML.

ai_context.instructions: Use this model for questions about court occupancy and utilisation. Reservation types are in Dutch; see the synonyms on reservation_type.
examples: What was court utilisation last summer?
Which court is booked most often?
How many slots were used for competition matches per month?

datasets.name: court_usage
datasets.description: One row per court slot, excluding winter-break days.

fields.name: slot_id
fields.description: Surrogate key for a slot: court, date and start time are unique together.

fields.name: start_hour
fields.label: Start hour
fields.description: Hour of day the slot starts (0-23).

fields.name: reservation_type
fields.label: Reservation type
fields.description: What the slot was used for. Beschikbaar = available, Gesloten = closed, Onderhoud = maintenance; everything else is a booking.

metrics.name: court_slots
metrics.description: All court slots in the period, whatever their status.

metrics.name: open_slots
metrics.description: Slots the courts were open for play: all slots except closed and maintenance.

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN reservation_type NOT IN ('Gesloten', 'Onderhoud') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.name: booked_slots
metrics.description: Slots used for any booking, lesson, match, tournament or rental.

dialects.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN reservation_type NOT IN ('Gesloten', 'Onderhoud', 'Beschikbaar') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metrics.name: court_utilization
metrics.description: Booked slots as a share of open slots.

dialects.expression: (SUM(CASE WHEN reservation_type NOT IN ('Gesloten', 'Onderhoud', 'Beschikbaar') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) / (SUM(CASE WHEN reservation_type NOT IN ('Gesloten', 'Onderhoud') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
